name: Qwen Flash-Next
summary: Qwen's experimental 125B-A6B hybrid-attention MoE. Its 51B n-gram embedding enables selective host placement, and the official FP8 export now serves cache-zero text through an exact 4K screen on four B70s; the lane remains research-only because short quality is still 5/7.

architecture.design: 125B total, about 6B active, plus 51B n-gram embedding and 4B MTP

series_measurements.quality: All points remain research-only because the same substantive short-quality miss reproduced. The 1K point passed its needle, repeats, and cache-zero realistic suite; the 2K and 4K points passed exact needles, fixed-set repeats, and separate formal cache-zero exact-depth gates.
series_measurements.caveat: The x=0 control used a 146-token ordinary prompt at configured max 512; x=1024 used exact p1024 at configured max 1536; x=2048 used exact p2048 at configured max 3072; x=4096 used exact p4096 at configured max 4352. Formal 99-interval results are separately labeled in the receipts. This is a bounded HTTP context screen across four additive server identities, not a deployment-qualified depth curve.
